problem_rationale: The plan requires dark/light parity, but the product currently declares a dark color scheme. Treating light mode as a current defect would expand the release substantially; ignoring forced colors would still leave an accessibility gap.
required_implementation: Decide whether light mode is a roadmap feature. Keep forced-colors/high-contrast support in the current accessibility gate regardless.

task_title: Consolidate time display options and define a constant-timeline-FPS policy for VFR sources, including normalization/proxy behavior
problem_rationale: The interface does not offer a consolidated current/total/remaining time display or an explicit policy for variable-frame-rate media. Reviewers must infer duration from separate regions, and VFR sources can undermine frame-based expectations.
required_implementation: Consolidate time display options and define a constant-timeline-FPS policy for VFR sources, including normalization/proxy behavior.

task_title: Define marker types and add them through a context menu or compact advanced-tools container rather than permanent toolbar chrome
problem_rationale: The sequence editor has no marker, chapter marker, or persistent review-note timeline model. Review feedback and repeated navigation must be managed outside the editor.
required_implementation: Define marker types and add them through a context menu or compact advanced-tools container rather than permanent toolbar chrome.
acceptance_criteria: Markers can be created, renamed, moved, searched, deleted, undone, and navigated by keyboard without obscuring the main playback surface.

task_title: Define transport semantics and expose accessible labeled Stop/Restart behavior only if it materially differs from Pause/Go to start
problem_rationale: Transport semantics are limited to play/pause, jump-to-start, and frame-step; there is no explicit Stop state or clearly labeled Restart command. Users coming from editing tools may not know whether pause preserves position, whether the start icon restarts, or how to stop all audition audio.
required_implementation: Define transport semantics and expose accessible labeled Stop/Restart behavior only if it materially differs from Pause/Go to start.
acceptance_criteria: The transport model is documented, labels match behavior, all media stops deterministically, and no redundant control is added without purpose.

task_title: Decide whether editorial preview supports 0
problem_rationale: There is no playback-speed control or documented decision to remain fixed at 1×. Power users cannot review timing at slow or accelerated rates, but adding speed without pitch/sync policy could create misleading review.
required_implementation: Decide whether editorial preview supports 0.25×–2×, then implement with pitch policy, keyboard shortcuts, clear state, and persistence.
acceptance_criteria: Supported speeds keep audio/picture synchronized and the chosen rate is always visible; unsupported rates are absent rather than implied.
